channel.title: Celestia
channel.description: Your vault, as a place in Finder.

item.title: Version 1.51.0
item.description: Saga disc jobs: drives by serial, one run per disc, Cancel/Retry, gates you can revise

item.title: Version 1.50.0
item.description: FabSight follows every Saga job's logs and keeps each disc's progress in its own run

item.title: Version 1.49.0
item.description: FabSight reads script-reported event files: Saga's progress is live per file and survives restarts

item.title: Version 1.47.0
item.description: Quick actions for Phoebe: action_list and action_receipts, think_harder, handing work to an agent waits for his yes, asks lapse after five minutes, and Phoebe runs one connector tool instead of starting a thread.

item.title: Version 1.46.0
item.description: An artifact an agent records with record_delivery appears in the open thread right away.

item.title: Version 1.45.0
item.description: Cerebro: questions and plans on every thread (answer cards, plan approval that can leave plan mode), plan files no longer a broken download, subagent canon and skills tools.

item.title: Version 1.44.0
item.description: Listing every agent's threads shows each one once (Cerebro's sidebar).

item.title: Version 1.43.0
item.description: Cerebro: threads in any folder, approval prompts for tool calls (deny with a note and the agent carries on), context fill per turn, transient errors retried by themselves, model/effort/mode changeable mid-thread.

item.title: Version 1.42.0
item.description: Phoebe can file one clear request through the engines herself (tasks, calendar, food, water, sleep, money), logged as her under the owning agent. Engine calls from any thread or terminal agent are now logged under the agent that made them. Her voice glance can file requests. Phoebe's own session runs under a write scope and sandbox, and noc phoebe now actually starts her session.

item.title: Version 1.41.0
item.description: Voice: turns reach Phoebe instantly — connections are accepted off the main thread.

item.title: Version 1.40.0
item.description: Voice: acknowledgements ready from the first turn; a named agent always gets the work.

item.title: Version 1.39.0
item.description: Voice: instant acknowledgement for slow rules, a warm ElevenLabs socket, delegation in his exact words.

item.title: Version 1.38.0
item.description: Voice conversations V1 Fixes: Fixes in addition to last ship which was - Phoebe talks while agents work — streamed speech, delegation, barge-in, spoken results.

item.title: Version 1.37.0
item.description: Voice conversations: Phoebe talks while agents work — streamed speech, delegation, barge-in, spoken results.

item.title: Version 1.36.0
item.description: Probe: the polling and driving calls no longer queue other clients' calls behind them (they took 25-33 s on a client), and a session's own noc mcp reaches the daemon's probe tools.

item.title: Version 1.35.0
item.description: Probe: a session can see and drive an app on any device (probe_call), for testing features without screenshots.

item.title: Version 1.34.0
item.description: The roster can no longer read empty (the daemon answered with the one-agent default, so no fabricator could start) and is parsed once per change; clients are told when the home Mac's calendar moves (meridian.changed); a persistent EventKit helper backs Meridian.

item.title: Version 1.33.0
item.description: Rebuild so the shipped app's signature verifies, and a daemon restart that reloads the vault roster. No behaviour changes.

item.title: Version 1.32.0
item.description: Intersects: agents now carry installable expert fields (software-engineer for Jarvis, clinical-health for Alaura), named in every launch's brief.

item.title: Version 1.31.0
item.description: One Brain: memory recall and approvals go through Arc's Hindsight, the one memory every heart shares. No Ollama needed.

item.title: Version 1.30.0
item.description: Hearts never stop: when Claude hits its usage limit (or its 5-hour window is 95% used), threads carry on on the heart's standby with a handoff brief, then come back after the reset.

item.title: Version 1.29.0
item.description: Usage per heart (Claude plan limits, OpenRouter credits, Lite's free allowances) and the canonical heart colours: Claude orange, Frontier yellow, Lite green.

item.title: Version 1.28.0
item.description: Aether: project folders are granted outright so headless chats can edit (locked files still denied), chats' files download, CLAUDE.md editing, hand-offs link back to the chat.

item.title: Version 1.27.0
item.description: Aether's substrate: projects in any folder, harness-enforced locks, per-turn checkpoints with revert, and plain-Claude chats that delegate to agents.

item.title: Version 1.26.0
item.description: Remote MCP connectors: Notion, PubMed, Linear and any registry server connect through the Supabase OAuth broker and reach the agents they're attached to.

item.title: Version 1.25.0
item.description: Hearts: every agent runs on its own power source — Claude Code or Arc-Code on a named brain chain — set per agent and inherited by subagents. Fabricators with steps run at the touch of a button: scripts directly, model steps on their subagent's heart, gates answered by you from a paired device. Every turn's heart, model and cost lands in the warehouse.

item.title: Version 1.24.0
item.description: Phoebe Mind: every talk with Phoebe kept and readable, with turns her rules handled carried into her next answer. FabSight closes runs that have gone silent for six hours.

item.title: Version 1.23.0
item.description: Alaura joins the Council: last night's sleep, yesterday's water against her target or your own goal, and (in Detailed) the sleep debt and today's planned meals — from her new engines, by rule. connector_call names every connector.

item.title: Version 1.22.0
item.description: The weekly backup works again: it now runs through Celestia's noc, which macOS lets read the vault.

item.title: Version 1.21.0
item.description: The Council takes your choices: which agents speak and how much each says (brief, normal, detailed).

item.title: Version 1.20.0
item.description: The Council: ask for your morning report and every agent pulls its part — calendar, planner, bills, the pipeline, the home Mac — assembled by rule, read aloud by Phoebe.

item.title: Version 1.19.0
item.description: Voice: Phoebe is a read-only window you can ask anything (what's running, what's due, disk space) — answered aloud, nothing saved. Name who does the work with 'hey <agent>'.

item.title: Version 1.18.0
item.description: Voice: spoken threads, per-agent voices, Phoebe routes requests to the right agent

item.title: Version 1.17.0
item.description: Voice: agents talk back — spoken threads, per-agent voices, voice tools, voice health on the Stack page

item.title: Version 1.16.0
item.description: Connector host for Friday's engines: connectors_list, connector_call and connector_admin run the vault's MCP connectors (Apollo tasks, Meridian calendar, Hermes read-only Gmail) through their own per-tool permission gate, and POST /mcp/<id> proxies any connector to paired clients. The roster understands orchestrators and deterministic engines (parent / engine / children); engines get no chat actions.

item.title: Version 1.15.1
item.description: Cleaning up File Provider registrations now keeps sweeping until no stray registration is left.

item.title: Version 1.15.0
item.description: Stack health: god_state facet:health is the whole stack as a tree of lights (LaunchAgents, server freshness, Finder extensions, release channels verified against their DMGs, Supabase, every client with per-device credential refusals) plus stack_restart. god_state no longer blocks every other call while it collects. Stream routes say why a credential was refused. Per-thread model, effort and billing mode. The ship script refuses a re-used version and verifies the upload before touching the appcast.

item.title: Version 1.14.0
item.description: FabSight lens authoring: agents can make any tool transparent — test, prove, save and attach a lens from the tool's own output (per-item progress, done/left of total), with coverage measured on every run, raw output kept, drift detection, and the fab-lens skill seeded into the vault.

item.title: Version 1.13.0
item.description: FabSight — every fabricator run seen stage by stage, reported or derived from the agent's own tool calls — plus live headless-thread telemetry (list, watch, shut down) and process detail (cpu, memory, working directory). The roster orb now says what a stage is doing.

item.title: Version 1.12.0
item.description: Threads carry real attachments (images, PDFs, files) and show a download card for anything an agent delivers. The roster's orb and activity line now track a running thread everywhere, not just Saga's disc pipeline.

item.title: Version 1.11.2
item.description: A thread whose Claude Code login expired now starts fresh on the next message instead of staying stuck on the old credentials.

item.title: Version 1.11.1
item.description: Stops registering noc-ytdl as an MCP server (it's a command-line tool) and removes the old registration, ending the noc-ytdl CONNECTION_CLOSED error in every Claude session.

item.title: Version 1.11.0
item.description: Threads stay warm (fast replies), Stop really stops and the next message continues, agents know which fabricators are theirs, and the home server no longer lets the Mac idle-sleep.

item.title: Version 1.10.1
item.description: Claude on the home Mac now reaches agent threads through the daemon, so every conversation is visible live in Tesseract.

item.title: Version 1.10.0
item.description: Agents can be talked to in threads: send_to_agent / list_threads / read_thread / cancel_thread over MCP, streamed replies for Tesseract's new Interface tab.

item.title: Version 1.9.5
item.description: Fixes a client-setup bug: the Home server field silently defaulted to this Mac's own loopback address when left blank, so a new client Mac's first setup could fail even with Tailscale working correctly. The field is now required.

item.title: Version 1.9.4
item.description: god_state no longer reports a home server as incomplete over items it simply didn't check, or over an optional companion app. Tesseract's setup screen now shows an accurate provisioning status.

item.title: Version 1.9.3
item.description: Verifies the self-update path end to end: the first release installed entirely by Celestia's own updater, with no manual step.

item.title: Version 1.9.2
item.description: Automatic update checks now actually run. Celestia's updater was only ever started by clicking Check for Updates, so background checks never happened; it now starts at launch.

item.title: Version 1.9.1
item.description: Setup, rebuilt: a new wizard, and a Tools tab that installs every dependency, tool, MCP registration and config repo this Mac needs from one manifest. Agent sessions running outdated tools are now flagged, and remote-MCP credentials are checked where the daemon actually reads them.

item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description: The daemon now discovers the data stack live (data_stack), answers read-only warehouse queries (data_stack_query), and runs the stack's Makefile commands in the background from any client (data_stack_run, data_stack_job). Health findings name the command that fixes them. Also fixes the Release build, which had been missing EventBus since Sep 12.

item.title: Version 1.8.10
item.description: Fix TERM missing in the prompt-into-tmux path — the prompt now actually lands where it's supposed to

item.title: Version 1.8.9
item.description: Unify prompts and hand-typed input into the same tmux session the Terminal tab watches

item.title: Version 1.8.8
item.description: Every live agent terminal, visible in one gallery. Auto-reconnect when a viewer window drops but the session is still alive on the server.

item.title: Version 1.8.7
item.description: Saga's pipeline: real per-title/per-file progress, live activity narration on the orb carousel, terminal typing + auto-mode for all agents

item.title: Version 1.8.6
item.description: Saga's pipeline reachable over MCP: saga_status and saga_events_recent

item.title: Version 1.8.5
item.description: Phase F and G — SQL store (sql_tables/sql_query/sql_exec) and approval-gate tools (list_proposals/read_proposal/resolve_proposal) reachable over MCP

item.title: Version 1.8.4
item.description: Manual Stop/Start for Delphi's standing session (closes/reopens the tmux session and its terminal window), and a fix for nudges stacking up unsubmitted after a restart.

item.title: Version 1.8.3
item.description: Delphi becomes a standing librarian: auto-starting terminal session, an editable filing pop-up instead of instant auto-filing, git health watched on a timer, and wakes automatically when something new lands in the vault.

item.title: Version 1.8.2
item.description: Renaming a folder now reaches every other Mac. A folder renamed on one Mac kept its old name elsewhere, and opening it there failed with 'items may be out of date'.

item.title: Version 1.8.1
item.description: Renames made on the home Mac now reach every client. Fixes a crash in the MCP server when its client disconnects, makes noc sync work from a client, and stops sync reporting success while commits sit unpushed.

item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description: Verbose tracing is on by default, so a transcript already exists when something breaks — no more reproducing a problem twice. The trace now rotates through bounded history files on disk instead of destroying old data when it fills up. The Developer Log window gains Export Full Log, which writes one file with the full ground-state diagnostics, the complete trace history, the full session log, and the home server's own log — built to hand straight to an AI agent.

item.title: Version 1.7.9
item.description: Fixes the diagnostics call locking up the vault server.

item.title: Version 1.7.8
item.description: Fixes the diagnostics call locking up the vault server.

item.title: Version 1.7.7
item.description: Fixes the diagnostics call locking up the vault server.

item.title: Version 1.7.6
item.description: Fixes the diagnostics call hanging the vault server.

item.title: Version 1.7.5
item.description: The server no longer ends up unresponsive after an update.

item.title: Version 1.7.4
item.description: Fixes the diagnostics call locking up the server when an AI agent asked for it.

item.title: Version 1.7.3
item.description: After an update the server sometimes started but never answered, leaving the vault empty in Finder. Celestia now checks that it is actually answering and restarts it if not.

item.title: Version 1.7.2
item.description: Diagnostics now report whether the server actually answers, not just whether it is running — and tell apart a server that is absent from one that has wedged.

item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description: Adds a diagnostics call that any connected AI agent can read: app and extension versions, whether each part of the server is healthy, the mount, recent errors, and a list of detected problems each with its fix. Also available as noc doctor.

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description: New Backup tab in Settings: see exactly what has changed, what is not yet backed up, the full history, and write the commit message with Apple's on-device model. The Server window now reports each part of the server separately — the background service, the process, the listener, tool calls and both Finder extensions — and can clear leftover registrations from old builds. The developer log now includes extension registrations, processes and mount state.

item.title: Version 1.6.4
item.description: New folders appear on other Macs right away, and two files can no longer end up sharing an identity.

item.title: Version 1.6.3
item.description: New folders now appear on other Macs right away.

item.title: Version 1.6.2
item.description: A new folder created on the home Mac now appears on other Macs immediately instead of waiting for the next full refresh.

item.title: Version 1.6.1
item.description: The noc command is installed as a small launcher instead of a copy, so macOS no longer removes it as malware — this was silently breaking the Claude MCP connection.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description: Files now keep a stable identity that survives renames and moves. This fixes the recurring 'items may be out of date' error and files that would not sync between Macs. Your Finder view rebuilds itself once after updating.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description: Right-click actions now work on the file you selected. Finder identifies files to the menu by two different internal ids, neither of which is a path; both are now translated back to the real file.

item.title: Version 1.4.9
item.description: Right-click actions now run against the file you selected. They were being handled in the wrong extension, which receives internal system identifiers rather than the file's real location.

item.title: Version 1.4.8
item.description: Right-click actions now resolve the file Finder points at, so Lock, Unlock, Copy Vault Path and Open in Obsidian work from the Quick Actions menu.

item.title: Version 1.4.7
item.description: Diagnostic build for the right-click actions: resolves files through the registered vault domain and records why a lookup fails.

item.title: Version 1.4.6
item.description: Fixes the right-click actions failing with a path error. Finder identifies files to the menu by its own internal id, which had to be translated back to a vault path.

item.title: Version 1.4.5
item.description: Fixes the right-click menu items being found but not shown. Their availability rule could not be evaluated by Finder, which drops an action silently.

item.title: Version 1.4.4
item.description: Celestia now enables its own Finder right-click menu. The menu's extension was being registered by macOS but left switched off, so the actions never appeared.

item.title: Version 1.4.3
item.description: The Finder right-click menu now actually appears. On macOS the menu is read from a separate extension type, which Celestia did not have — the actions were declared in a bundle Finder never asks. Lock, Unlock, Copy Vault Path, Open in Obsidian and Check the Vault for Changes are now in the menu.

item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description: Fixes the Finder right-click menu, the lock badge and the updated badge labels not appearing: the extension's own version had never changed since the first release, so macOS kept serving cached metadata from that install.

item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description: Locking a file on the home Mac now reaches connected Macs immediately instead of waiting for an unrelated change.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Lock any file or folder from Finder's right-click menu — a locked item cannot be changed, renamed, moved or deleted by anything, including agents, because it uses macOS's own immutable flag rather than a marker only Celestia would respect. Cloud badges now explain themselves: Finder's native progress and error UI show what is happening and what went wrong. New right-click actions: Copy Vault Path, Open in Obsidian, Check the Vault for Changes. Editing a note's body no longer reformats its frontmatter.

item.title: Version 1.3.9
item.description: Fixes edits from a client failing to save when that Mac was set to need approval — Celestia now identifies itself as a person, and a person's own save is never queued for their own review. The vault index is fetched incrementally instead of whole, so an edit costs kilobytes rather than megabytes on every connected Mac.

item.title: Version 1.3.8
item.description: Finder is much faster: the vault index is fetched once and shared instead of re-downloaded for every file shown, and edits now sync as incremental changes rather than forcing a full re-read of the whole vault. Transient network drops retry instead of leaving an error badge. New Developer Log window with verbose tracing, on clients as well as the home server.

item.title: Version 1.3.7
item.description: Much faster in Finder. Browsing a folder used to re-download the entire vault index for every single file it showed; it is now fetched once, shared, and kept up to date with real incremental changes instead of a full re-read on every edit. Transient network drops retry instead of leaving an error badge. Adds a Developer Log window with verbose tracing, on clients as well as the home server.

item.title: Version 1.3.6
item.description: Fix: installing an update could shut the background server down and fail to start it again, leaving every client showing an empty vault. Restarting the server now waits for macOS instead of racing it, and no longer freezes the app while it works.

item.title: Version 1.3.5
item.description: Fix: the vault mounted on a client Mac but showed nothing, and auto-update was rejected as improperly signed. Both are fixed; updating by hand from this DMG is needed once.

item.title: Version 1.3.4
item.description: Fix: installing an update left the previous background server running, so fixes did not take effect until it was restarted by hand. Celestia now detects and restarts a stale server on launch.

item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description: Fix: approving a client on the home server, then the client retrying, could silently un-approve it again — this was the cause of a real cross-Mac pairing getting stuck in a loop.

item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description: Fix: pairing with a home server on another Mac was silently blocked by macOS security settings, not by anything Tailscale-related.

item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description: Fix: dev/test builds no longer share production state with the installed app on the same Mac.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: Sync the vault to git from the menu bar or the Vault tab, with a badge showing how many files are waiting. Turn notifications and the weekly backup on or off in Settings. Check for updates from the menu bar.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: Celestia is now the whole product. Register the vault with Claude Desktop and Claude Code in one click, watch vault health, and review agent writes before they land. Installs and keeps the noc command in step with the server.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: Choose whether this Mac hosts the vault or connects to one. Home servers get a server dashboard, client approval, and a copyable diagnostics log. Clearer errors when Tailscale isn't connected.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description: First packaged release: menu-bar app, popover, onboarding, Finder sync-status badges, and auto-update.
